titleInfo.title: Your next five moves
titleInfo.subTitle: master the art of business strategy

agent.namePart: Gallery Books, an imprint of Simon & Schuster, Inc.,

abstract.#text: "What do successful entrepreneurs and chess grandmasters have in common? The vision and mindset to look at the pieces in front of them and anticipate what role each one plays in the next five moves. Now, with the principles explored in Your Next Five Moves, aspiring entrepreneurs and anyone looking to excel in their career can hone the vital skills needed to consider long-term goals, anticipate future challenges, and sharpen their shrewd strategic reasoning. Using his own career trajectory-from hot-tempered and insecure salesman to strategic and self-aware CEO-Patrick Bet-David translates the entrepreneurial journey into an accessible and valuable methodology that will advance your career simply by anticipating the next five moves"-- Provided by publisher.

tableOfContents.#text: Introduction: Before your first move -- Move 1: Master knowing yourself. Who do you want to be? ; Study the most important product: you ; Your path to creating wealth: intrapreneur or entrepreneur? -- Move 2: Master the ability to reason. The incredible power of processing issues ; How to solve for X: a methodology for effective decision making -- Move 3: Master building the right team. The myth of the solopreneur: how to build your team ; Create a principles-based culture ; Trust = Speed: the power of reliability -- Move 4: Master strategy to scale. Scaling for exponential growth ; Make momentum your friend- and be prepared for chaos ; Moneyball: designing systems to track your business ; Stay paranoid: the grand master never lets his guard down -- Move 5: Master power plays. How to beat Goliath and control the narrative ; Study mobsters: how to sell, negotiate, and influence ; Cultivate your power, and stay battle tested -- Conclusion: check mate -- Acknowledgments -- Appendix A: personal identity audit -- Appendix B: solve for X worksheet.
